criteria_results.text: The desktop app launched from the pull-request worktree starts its local agent server and makes it reachable on port 4001.
criteria_results.notes: AJ reported that the launched desktop app had no agent-server connection; direct health probes to 127.0.0.1:4001 were refused. The Flutter desktop binary was running, but the isolated worktree had no apps/api_server/node_modules and no PR-worktree API process started.

process_issues.description: The launch preflight installed Flutter and mobile dependencies but did not verify package-local api_server dependencies before flutter run. The desktop shell built and opened while its npx tsx child could not start from the dependency-empty PR worktree.
process_issues.detected_by: User-visible disconnected state, connection-refused health probes, process inspection, and the missing apps/api_server/node_modules directory.

process_issues.description: After API dependencies were restored, a plain Flutter relaunch selected the stock PATH OpenCode binary. That binary rejected the current managed config key 'reference', so the API was healthy but agent sessions remained unavailable until RHYTHM_OPENCODE_BIN_DIR selected the PR worktree fork.
process_issues.detected_by: Flutter/api_server logs showed 'engine: opencode resolved from PATH', 'Unrecognized key: reference', and ECONNREFUSED on port 4096; the corrected relaunch logged the PR fork path and 'SDK initialized'.

failure_output: AJ: problem w/ desktop - no agent server connecting. curl: (7) Failed to connect to 127.0.0.1 port 4001. Flutter stderr: Error: Cannot find module 'dotenv'; require stack: apps/api_server/src/server.ts. ApiServerService: Server exited with code 1; Server did not become ready in time.
suggested_follow_up: Before a worktree-local Flutter smoke, require apps/api_server/node_modules/.bin/tsx, launch with the built PR fork through RHYTHM_OPENCODE_BIN_DIR, and assert both /health and /opencode/health before handoff.
